text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up  Ivy (Engineering Manager) starts Monday 10:00 PT. I put together a compact first-14-days checklist for managers (short, actionable). Can folks confirm ownership by EOD Friday?

Lena (People Ops): Day-before essentials (one-liners):
```
- Laptop + power shipped and tracked
- Okta + MFA invite sent
- Slack + email + calendar provisioned
- Notion access: /team/eng/managers granted
- 1Password manager vault access granted
- Welcome note + 14-day agenda emailed
```

Omar (IT): Device imaged (MacBook Pro). Shipping eta Fri 2pm. Will install dev image, Docker, VSCode, VPN, and add to `eng-dev` group. Need confirmation for any special tooling.

Lee (Eng): Start with `eng-dev`. We'll request `eng-prod` after the 30-day check-in. I'll be Ivy's buddy week1 and run an infra walkthrough.

Priya (Recruiting): Ill schedule a 1:1 with the recruiter for hiring process orientation in week 1 and share the hiring bar link.

Maya (People Ops): First-14-days manager rhythm (minimal, copyable):
Mon (day 1): 10:00 welcome + ops (15m), 11:00 team kickoff (30m), 15:00 1:1 w/ director (30m)
Tue (d2): buddy shadow + infra walkthrough (60m)
Wed (d3): product & PM context (30m) + team norms intro (20m)
Thu (d4): write-first-30 plan draft + hiring sync (45m)
Fri (d5): skip-level AMA + week1 retro (30m)
Week 2: deeper stakeholder 1:1s, start onboarding win task, recruiting/compensation sync, OSS/dep overview

Maya (People Ops): Suggested short milestones to include in Ivy's 30/60/90-lite doc (single-line verbs):
- 30d: onboard team, ship an onboarding win (doc/PR), understand service health signals
- 60d: run a planning session, propose two small reliability/perf improvements
- 90d: lead a roadmap initiative slice and own hiring inputs for role(s)

Lee (Eng): Can we add an "office hours" slot with platform leads twice in week 2? Helps unblock infra questions quickly.

Maya (People Ops): Good calladded two 30-min office hours blocks to week 2.

onboard-bot: Reminder created: "Ivy - prestart checklist" Fri 17:00 PT.

Omar (IT): :white_check_mark: Device imaged, shipping label created. Will DM tracking once scanned.

Lee (Eng): :white_check_mark: Buddy + infra walkthrough confirmed. Ill prepare a tiny onboarding PR so Ivy has a hands-on win.

Priya (Recruiting): :white_check_mark: Recruiter 1:1 slot and hiring bar link queued.

Lena (People Ops): :white_check_mark: Welcome note + 14-day agenda sent (pending Ivy acceptance).

Maya (People Ops): Who-to-ask cheat-sheet (micro):
- Payroll / comp: Lena
- Hardware / accounts: Omar
- Infra / cluster access: Lee / #platform-eng
- Hiring / recruiter: Priya
- Security & compliance: #eng-security

Ivy (new-hire): Thanks everyone  appreciate the clear plan. Quick Q: can someone add the codebase readme link to the welcome pack?

Lee (Eng): Done  added repo readme and a suggested first-issue to the Notion page.

Maya (People Ops): Please react with :white_check_mark: when your items are complete so I can close the checklist. Ill publish the consolidated Notion doc and DM Ivy the calendar invites."
